what.text: This page follows Venezuelans abroad whom UNHCR counts as other people in need of international protection, a group separate from refugees and asylum seekers.
At the end of 2025 there were 6042706 people in this group, and Colombia hosts the largest share, 46.5%.
Peru, Chile, Brazil and Ecuador are the next largest hosts.

why.text: The sources here don't say why people left Venezuela.
UNHCR's figures describe the scale of the movement, not its causes.

when.text: UNHCR's figures for this group start in 2018 at 2592947 and reach 6042706 in 2025.
The main years in the data are 2019 to 2025.

how.text: These are year-end totals reported to UNHCR; refugees and asylum seekers from Venezuela are counted in separate series and are not added here.
The sources don't say how people travelled.
